plan.early: Stack Globe of Annihilation on full waves, ping so team leaves you the wave; send Demon Lieutenant to empty lanes on cooldown.
plan.mid: At 10 take Demonic Invasion: drop it on a fort while your team stalls the objective, trading siege for their attention.
plan.fight: Open with max-range Globe on clumps, channel All Shall Burn only behind your front; cancel it the second a stun threatens.
plan.late: Late you win via a 200+ stack Globe and constant three-lane push; you lose if stunned mid-channel, so track their CC.

azmodan.solo: Strong solo laner: wins the sustained wave war while stacking Globe, but hard dive punishes his total lack of escape.

plan.early: Fend the wave, keep moving so Avoidance armor stays up, and throw Lightning Fury through gates to stack Thunderstroke.
plan.mid: At 10 take Ball Lightning: bounce it between two stunned targets at objectives, then Fend through the leftovers.
plan.fight: Your job is deleting their auto-attackers: Blinding Light the Valla or Raynor, then Fend blinded targets for bonus damage.
plan.late: Late, Infinite Lightning bounces win extended fights; stay stutter-stepping, standing still drops Avoidance and you melt.

cassia.solo: Can offlane into auto-attack bruisers thanks to Avoidance and Blind, but loses to mages and heavy CC; a niche counterpick.

plan.early: Poke Sand Blast on cooldown from max range and finish Timewalker's Pursuit; you outrange everyone, never take return fire.
plan.mid: At her early 10 take Slowing Sands: drop it on the objective choke and Dragon's Breath anyone who sits in the slow.
plan.fight: Sit two screens back, spam Sand Blast into their frontline, and save Time Trap for the Zeratul or Tracer coming for you.
plan.late: Late you outrange keeps and win every poke war, but one dive kills you; never move without a Time Trap planted behind you.

plan.early: Trade with Hammerang plus autos, keep Barrel Roll pocketed, and use Flight to double-soak the moment your wave is safe.
plan.mid: At 10 take Mighty Gust: fly cross-map to arrive first at objectives, then Gust their team off the point or into yours.
plan.fight: Stutter-step their frontline, hook Lightning Rod on whoever stays in range, and hold Gust to cancel a Mosh or peel divers.
plan.late: Late, Flight lets you soak and still make every fight; dying to stealth ganks mid-rotation is how you throw it.

falstad.solo: Not a true solo laner, but Flight covers the solo lane in a pinch and punishes offlaners who overextend without vision.

plan.early: Swap weapons smartly: Repeater Cannon for trades, Phase Bomb for wave; poke Plasma Cutter plus autos while shields eat free.
plan.mid: At 10 take Purification Salvo: tag the two squishiest heroes at objectives, then Repeater Cannon them as the salvo lands.
plan.fight: Max-range stutter-step with Repeater Cannon, Plasma Cutter their retreat path, and Warp out the moment your shield breaks.
plan.late: Late, Offensive Cadence third shots win DPS races; Warp's delay is your risk, start it before they land on you, not after.

fenix.solo: Can hold a solo lane briefly on shields and waveclear, but zero sustain means he bleeds health; better in a duo lane.

plan.early: Life Tap freely then Fel Flame the wave; you never leave lane for mana, just don't Tap below half with their ganker missing.
plan.mid: At 10 take Horrify: at objectives fear their frontline off your carries, or flip a dive the second they jump your backline.
plan.fight: Corruption the clump, Drain Life whoever your tank roots, and keep Healthstone for the burst window right after a Life Tap.
plan.late: Late, Haunt plus Darkness Within makes you a raid boss; mobile assassins are the loss condition, hug peel and pre-aim Horrify.

plan.early: Storm Bow pokes at max range for Target Practice stacks; Sonic Arrow every bush before you step up, never facecheck.
plan.mid: At 10 take Dragon's Arrow: fire from mid range so the stun lands, then full Storm Bow charge plus Scatter on the stunned target.
plan.fight: Live at max bow range, ricochet Scatter Arrow off walls into melee, and keep Natural Agility strictly as your escape.
plan.late: Late, Bullseye stuns turn picks into won fights; divers are your risk, hop terrain early, not after they land on you.

plan.early: One Blizzard clears the caster wave; poke Frostbolt into Ice Lance combos and keep Cone of Cold for anyone who jumps you.
plan.mid: At 10 take Water Elemental: open objective fights with Elemental plus Blizzard on the clump for chained Frostbite slows.
plan.fight: Hold Ring of Frost for their dive, chain Cone of Cold slows so melee never reach you, burst the rooted target with Ice Lance.
plan.late: Late your combo one-shots squishies, but you are the squishiest thing alive; play behind two bodies and pre-cast on chokes.

plan.early: Lob Frag Launcher at the front edge of their hitbox so grenades bounce in; trap the bush, keep Concussion Mine for escapes.
plan.mid: At 10 take RIP-Tire: drive it in from fog at objectives to split their team, then spam frags into the choke they retreat through.
plan.fight: Shell the clump from behind your tank, pre-place Steel Trap on the flank route, and mine divers off your healer, not for damage.
plan.late: Late you zone entire chokes and Total Mayhem trades even in death; mobile assassins are still your death sentence, hug peel.

plan.early: Verdant Spheres Living Bomb one-shots the caster wave and feeds Mana Addict; Gravity Lapse anyone who walks at you.
plan.mid: At 10 take Phoenix: land it on the objective so it zones and sieges, and save Verdant Spheres for the follow-up Flamestrike.
plan.fight: Spread Living Bomb into their clump, empowered Flamestrike the stunned target; hold Lapse for the diver, it is your only peel.
plan.late: Late an empowered bomb chain wipes teams; you die in one rotation though, so cast from fog and never lead the walk-up.

plan.early: Every Chains hit on a hero builds Master of the Cold Dark; fish combos in lane, finishing the quest early is your whole game.
plan.mid: At 10 take Frost Blast: Chains a target, root the clump, then land the full combo and Death and Decay on the frozen pile.
plan.fight: One combo decides it: Chains the frontliner to a wall, Frost Nova the pair, then recast Chains through Glacial Spike.
plan.late: Late with quest done you one-combo squishies; you have zero escapes, so combo from range and keep a body between you and dives.

plan.early: Magic Missiles on cooldown, hero hits refund mana with Charged Blast; throw Arcane Orb only at max range where it hurts.
plan.mid: At 10 take Wave of Force into dive or channel comps; fish for one objective kill, the reset refreshes everything, re-engage.
plan.fight: Third line, max range: Orb the clump, Missiles the low target, Teleport aggressively ONLY when the reset kill is guaranteed.
plan.late: Late every reset chains another kill and Tal Rasha ramps; overchasing after one Teleport is how you hand the fight back.

plan.early: Poison autos then hop back and let Nature's Toxin tick; Noxious Blossom the wave, never burn Leaping Strike to engage.
plan.mid: At 10 take Thornwood Vine: weave the three-hit vines through objective fights to keep toxin rolling on their whole team.
plan.fight: Kite at max range, keep poison ticking on every enemy the healer must save, save Leaping Strike for the Butcher on you.
plan.late: Late your dot pressure breaks single-target healers; AoE-cleanse healers blank you, so spread toxin wider, not deeper.

lunara.solo: Real offlane option: outranges melee bruisers, poisons and skips away, but a gank with Leaping Strike down usually kills her.

plan.early: Lightning Nova the wave then walk it onto their melee; every hero hit refunds cooldowns, so you win trades by circling.
plan.mid: At 10 take Durance of Hate: at objectives Shade in, Nova the clump, and throw Skull Missile as you snap back to safety.
plan.fight: Shade behind them, spin Lightning Nova through max targets, and aim Durance at slowed or rooted heroes so it cannot miss.
plan.late: Late, Nova with full CDR is a fight-long AoE; the snapback spot is your life, never cast Shade from a losing position.

plan.early: Every minion killed by an ability stacks Voodoo Ritual; Spiders plus Blossom each wave, hit big stacks early or fall off.
plan.mid: At 10 take Gargantuan: drop it at objectives for the stomp slow, and trap their bruiser in Zombie Wall for your team.
plan.fight: Wall the diver off your healer or wall their tank in, Blossom plus Spiders inside it, and keep Ice Block for when they turn.
plan.late: Late, Vile Infection makes toxin lethal; if the quest is not done you are a minion, so soak waves relentlessly all game.

nazeebo.solo: Passable solo laner on big maps: safe ranged clear while stacking Ritual, but loses hard to dive bruisers before Ice Block.

plan.early: Gank, don't lane: Pinning Shot into Snipe from cloak on overextended squishies; Holo Decoy baits abilities before you commit.
plan.mid: At 10 take Precision Strike: snipe objective fights from fog, and use it globally to clear far catapult waves between fights.
plan.fight: You are a finisher, not an opener: wait for CC, Pinning Shot into Snipe on the 60 percent target, recloak, reposition, repeat.
plan.late: Late, Rewind doubles your burst combo; if their tank buys reveal or Zarya bubbles your target, swap marks fast or go siege.

plan.early: Chomp the wave for safe clear, poke Shadow Waltz from range, and bank Chaos stacks; the dash is your escape, not damage.
plan.mid: At 10 take Eternal Feast: land it on two-plus heroes at objectives and keep dealing damage so it re-triggers through the fight.
plan.fight: Aim Dread slightly behind slowed targets so wave and eruption both hit, then dump Chaos autos; Waltz backward out of dives.
plan.late: Late, Dead Magic turns your autos into AoE burst; hold Waltz for their engage every time, cooldown greed is how you die.

plan.early: Pylon in the bush, Warp Rift under the wave, pop it with Disruption Pulse; you win every clear war if pylons survive.
plan.mid: At 10 take Pylon Overcharge: pre-build pylons at the objective choke and force them to fight inside your cannon field.
plan.fight: Fight inside your power field: chain Warp Rifts in the choke, detonate with Pulse as they clump, retreat pylon to pylon.
plan.late: Late, Construct Additional Pylons makes objectives fortresses; caught without a field you are the slowest squishy alive.

probius.solo: Zone-control offlaner: pylons and rifts hold waves forever and deny trades, but dive bruisers demolish him one on one.
